release-auditor authored no DG4 implementation, test, register row, ADR, repair, delivery decision, history rewrite or finding fix. That includes T-DG4-FE-R11 (frontend-ux-engineer), T-DG4-BE-R7 (backend-workflow-engineer), D-137 to D-139 and the round-10 freeze (delivery-orchestrator). I raised F-DG4-160 in round 9 and verify it here as its reporter; its repair is the frontend-ux-engineer's. qa-verifier appears among the authors only for its pre-freeze acceptance tests (tests/qa, e2e), which the protocol allows; REQ-DLV-036's owners are the three implementers, and domain-reviewer covers it independently.

I audited the frozen candidate directly:
- a complete disposable clone, $TMPDIR/c (git clone, not a worktree; not shallow; all 97 branches and the tag; fsck clean apart from dangling objects);
- a second clone, $TMPDIR/u, at e70ac02 for builds, tests and mutants. It was restored to a clean git status after each mutant.

I read the three round-10 specialist records only after the freeze and after their runs had ended (all three finished before my run started). My only writes are this record, its verifications sidecar, the gate record and evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/audit/round-10/. All product data cited is SYNTHETIC.
